description: List the problems RankParse has found on the user's websites: the same list as the Issues tab in the RankParse dashboard, worst first. Types: not-indexed (tracked pages Google has not indexed, or has not confirmed yet), click-drop (tracked queries that lost at least 30% of their clicks or fell off page one, last 4 weeks against the 4 before), low-ctr (Google queries on page one with well under half the usual click-through rate for their position), connection (a Search Console, Bing or Yandex source that needs reconnecting or failed to sync), ai-visibility and site-health (failing checks from the daily site scan, paid plans only). Each issue has a title, detail, evidence lines, affected pages, a suggested_task to act on, links to the dashboard and, for not-indexed, indexnow_urls (pages not submitted to IndexNow in the last 24 hours: pass them to propose_indexnow_submit). For one page's Google index details use get_indexing_status or get_gsc_url_inspection; after fixing a scan issue use recheck_ai_visibility. Reads stored data (synced daily); it is not a live crawl. Without site_id it covers the workspace: not-indexed, click-drop, low-ctr and connection issues for the 25 most recently synced websites (truncated: true says other websites were left out of those four types), and ai-visibility and site-health issues for up to 500 websites. limit caps the list at 100 with no paging; total says how many matched. 0 credits.

site_id.description: Logical RankParse website ID, from list_websites or list_rank_tracking_sites. Omit for every website in the workspace.
